findings.title: Conditions for Termination for Cause
findings.rationale: The contract specifies conditions under which it can be terminated, including the requirement for a 90-day notice and full reconciliation of outstanding invoices and obligations.
evidence_excerpts: Early termination: 90-day notice with full reconciliation of outstanding invoices and obligations.
